bodyControlCalibration.basis: Local rotations after reference quaternion: forearm +X moves hands toward model +Z; calf -X moves feet toward -Z; spine Y is vertical.
bodyControlCalibration.limits: Authored demonstration ranges. Recalibrate axes and ranges for other rigs.
bodyControlCalibration.morphs: Optional authored per-side bicep targets; profile auToMorphs may also bind existing center skin/clothing morphs.
